rows.grounds: bahuvrihi compound sārasa+akṣa; nominative singular masculine form with final visarga rendered as ś before ca
proper name; nominative singular masculine with sandhi o before following voiced consonant
adverb indicating subsequent position in sequence

items.question: Which figures are named as continuing the revealed sequence thereafter?
premises: The lotus-eyed one and Śuka are named together.
Megha is named in the same sequence.
The sequence continues thereafter with what follows.
items.inference: The lotus-eyed one, Śuka, and Megha are enumerated as subsequent figures in the ongoing sequence.
uncertainties: Whether sārasa+ākṣaś is an epithet of Śuka or names a distinct figure is not explicit.
items.plain_english: And the lotus-eyed one, Śuka, and Megha come next in the sequence thereafter.
